dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent features include a top-center 'C' shape with a thick, granular white perimeter; a large right-center elongated 'O' with a highly irregular, scalloped boundary; and a lower-center 'O' with a gradient transitioning from a sharp high-intensity exterior to a diffuse interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity white clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the leftmost visible margin and scattered as singular pixel-points near the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the top-center, right-center, and lower-center macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. A secondary tight cluster of four smaller annuli on the left margin forms an irregular quadrilateral relationship.
